## Introduction The class opens with the reading of 1 Maccabees 1:24-29 and the prayer of 2 Maccabees 1:24-29: O Lord, Lord God, Creator of all things, who art fearful and strong, and righteous, and merciful; gather those together that are scattered from us, deliver them that serve among the heathen, look upon them that are despised and abhorred, and let the heathen know that thou art our God; punish them that oppress us, and with pride do us wrong. Sad news before class: the seven year old son of a brother in the Ghana school passed away from malaria; the funeral was held yesterday. Prayers and condolences to the family, and whatever they need from us, we will do. The thumbnail for today's class: The Madmen of China and their hatred for black people. The class takes up the boycott of Asian-owned businesses now spreading among our people, identifies who the Chinese, Japanese, Koreans, Vietnamese, and Mongolians are in the scriptures, and reads the prophecies of what the Most High says he will do to Moab and Ammon in the latter days. ## In The News Videos played in class around the boycott: - An Asian man online mocked the boycott of Asian businesses: get rid of the takeout, the dry cleaners, the beauty supply; you are being outworked by immigrants; boycott, I am all for it. Well, now the boycott is on, and I am all for it. Sisters, stop buying that fake hair from them. They do not like you; they hate you. - The angry Chinese lady: she blamed our people for the killing of a black boy by a store owner, saying if you had disciplined your boy he would not have been in someone's store trying to steal a fifty cent bottle of water, and pointing to the black jurors who found the shooter not guilty. But the boy did not steal any water: he left his bag at the front, took the water out and put it back, showed his pockets, and left the store. They chased him for a hundred and thirty yards and shot the boy in the back. He ran because he was scared; he is a boy with two grown men chasing behind him. - A response video exposed that woman: her online persona and accent are fake, public records contradict her story, and she has her own record of victimizing people; after it circulated she deleted her accounts. And on the victim mentality talking point: when a rapist rapes somebody, is that person a victim? Did we get raped during slavery? We are victims, and we are not going to forget it. That talking point is designed to get us to be quiet, and it does not work on us. If you rob me, I am going to keep saying you are a robber. - Another commentator said the boycott will not hold: where are you going to get your weave, Walmart? It is still made by the Chinese; Amazon, still made by the Chinese; and the moment the paycheck comes, it is right back to the hair, feet, and nails. That proves the point: too many of our women have been raised to despise the way they look, running after fake hair, fake nails, and lashes China makes. Sisters, love your hair and your complexion. And brothers, some of you are the reason for it, talking about the hair textures and complexions you prefer; you hate the way you look, and that spirit lands on the women.
Reading from on-screen text on hair and beauty supply stores *[[34:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=2084s)]* > Hair and beauty supply stores. The most documented intersection of black spending at Asian-owned businesses is in the ethnic beauty supply sector. > > Overall beauty spending. Black consumers spend 9.4 billion on beauty products annually, accounting for 11.1 to 12.5% of the total US beauty market. > > The hair care product: black hair care specifically is a $2.51 billion industry. Black women spend roughly 9 times more on ethnic hair products than non-black consumers.
- The Natasha stress doll: a stress relief toy resembling a small black baby is going viral, with users squeezing, stomping, throwing, and running it over for content. The dolls come in multiple colors, yet the trend focuses on this specific version. Make your own decision about what that trend is. - A man who admitted burning a cross in Grant Park, Chicago, topped with a MAGA hat, gave a softball interview claiming he never learned what a burning cross means in America. What man gets an interview first before the police lock him up? You cannot make this stuff up. ## Scriptures Opened **[John 5:39](/bible/john/5#v39)** *[[15:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=955s)]* > [39](/bible/john/5#v39) Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me. - Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me. Our job is to search the scriptures. The nations do not search the scriptures; they leave their searching from Matthew to Revelation with their misunderstanding through Christianity. If you start from Genesis, you find out that salvation and rulership of the earth is for the Israelites through Christ. Precepts: - **[Acts 17:11](/bible/acts/17#v11)** > [11](/bible/acts/17#v11) These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. When Paul presented the truth of Christ, they searched the scriptures daily to see if what Paul taught was accurate. That is what we have to do. - **[Proverbs 25:2](/bible/proverbs/25#v2)** > [2](/bible/proverbs/25#v2) It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter. It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter. When God conceals something in parables, metaphors, and allegories, it is our job to figure out what the Lord means. - **[Deuteronomy 29:29](/bible/deuteronomy/29#v29)** > [29](/bible/deuteronomy/29#v29) The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law. The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever. What God has kept secret and then revealed is for our children and our children's children. What we bring out in the scriptures is meant for our sons and daughters; teach them, and do not let this truth fall by the wayside. **[Jeremiah 48:1](/bible/jeremiah/48#v1)** *[[18:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=1114s)]* > [1](/bible/jeremiah/48#v1) Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed. - Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel. Unless you search the scriptures and pray to the Lord, you read that and say, I do not know who Moab is, and move on to the next chapter. **[Jeremiah 49:1](/bible/jeremiah/49#v1)** *[[19:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=1147s)]* > [1](/bible/jeremiah/49#v1) Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities? - Concerning the Ammonites: I do not know who the Ammonites are, and I do not know who Gad is, so I will stick to Matthew through Revelation. That is what the churches do. They stay confused, unable to identify who these nations are today. Christians do not know; Muslims do not know. **[2 Esdras 15:46](/bible/2-esdras/15#v46)** *[[19:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=1195s)]* > [46](/bible/2-esdras/15#v46) And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person: - And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person. Now let's see who Asia is. Let's examine Asia. Give me the primary countries and territories of East Asia, cuz that's what it's talking about.

K-pop cinema. > > North Korea, Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Located on the northern half of the Korean Peninsula, characterized by its distinct isolated political system. > > Mongolia, a vast landlocked country in the continental interior known for its geography and nomadic heritage. > > Taiwan, Republic of China, an island nation that is a global leader in high tech manufacturing and semiconductor production. - All right, that's all I want from that.
**[1 Maccabees 11:21](/bible/1-maccabees/11#v21)** *[[26:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=1601s)]* > [21](/bible/1-maccabees/11#v21) Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower, - Then certain ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king. The Chinese lady made a point to say black jurors found the man who shot the boy not guilty. There has always been a certain remnant of our people who love other races better than their own. What was true during the time of the Maccabees is true today: you have got Christians who hate their own people. - And on the handout talking point: everybody knows the Asian community had a hand out. When the government was giving them loans to open businesses in the black community, the government was denying black people loans; that is documented history. And during World War II, when America put the Japanese in internment camps, they paid them reparations when they let them out. So it is very amusing that they use this talking point on us. **[Genesis 19:29-38](/bible/genesis/19#v29)** *[[42:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=2521s)]* > [29](/bible/genesis/19#v29) And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt. > > [30](/bible/genesis/19#v30) And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters. > > [31](/bible/genesis/19#v31) And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth: > > [32](/bible/genesis/19#v32) Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father. > > [33](/bible/genesis/19#v33) And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose. > > [34](/bible/genesis/19#v34) And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father. > > [35](/bible/genesis/19#v35) And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose. > > [36](/bible/genesis/19#v36) Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father. > > [37](/bible/genesis/19#v37) And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day. > > [38](/bible/genesis/19#v38) And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben–ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day. - Sodom and Gomorrah have just been destroyed, and Lot dwells in a cave with his two daughters. They think everybody on the planet is dead: our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth. Both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father. - And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day. And the younger bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day. - When I came into this truth in the nineties, our elders already taught us that Moab is the Chinese and Ammon is the Japanese. It was not until recently that we found the books.

By this tree worked out on page 18, you will see at once that Japan and China versus Ben-ammi and Moab of old are of Shemitic origin. > This proving of Japan to be the children of Ammon carries with it the claim that the Chinese are the children of Moab. - So, we didn't get that first. This came way later. We recently found these things.

The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof. We are at that mustard seed stage now. All nations are going to submit to the King of kings. **[Isaiah 16:6](/bible/isaiah/16#v6)** *[[1:00:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=3603s)]* > [6](/bible/isaiah/16#v6) We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so. - We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so. Even today people say the next world superpower is going to be China; the prophecy says there shall be no more praise of Moab. - Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen. When you read the history of Moab, they hated and despised our people; I will show you that. - For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: captivity, prisoners of war. This goes with 2 Esdras 15:46-63 on the destruction of Asia and Babylon. - Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away. When Nebuchadnezzar came through, a lot of them fled far east. Some got caught; some did not. **[Daniel 11:41](/bible/daniel/11#v41)** *[[1:07:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=4068s)]* > [41](/bible/daniel/11#v41) He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon. - Speaking of the Greeks: he shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon. So during the time of the Greeks there were still remnants of Moab and Ammon in those lands; everybody did not leave at once. **[2 Maccabees 5:6-9](/bible/2-maccabees/5#v6)** *[[1:09:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XyhSewrzz0&t=4160s)]* > [6](/bible/2-maccabees/5#v6) But Jason slew his own citizens without mercy, not considering that to get the day of them of his own nation would be a most unhappy day for him; but thinking they had been his enemies, and not his countrymen, whom he conquered. > > [7](/bible/2-maccabees/5#v7) Howbeit for all this he obtained not the principality, but at the last received shame for the reward of his treason, and fled again into the country of the Ammonites. > > [8](/bible/2-maccabees/5#v8) In the end therefore he had an unhappy return, being accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians, fleeing from city to city, pursued of all men, hated as a forsaker of the laws, and being had in abomination as an open enemy of his country and countrymen, he was cast out into Egypt. > > [9](/bible/2-maccabees/5#v9) Thus he that had driven many out of their country perished in a strange land, retiring to the Lacedemonians, and thinking there to find succour by reason of his kindred: - Jason, the wicked Israelite who slew his own citizens without mercy, fled again into the country of the Ammonites, and in the end was accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians.
